note.zh: 塞缪尔·巴特勒散文英译（1900）
威廉·卡伦·布莱恩特诗体英译（1871–1872）

review.en: The first great homecoming story, built with surprising cunning: it begins with a son searching, lets the hero tell his own wonders at a stranger’s table, and spends its second half in a single house. Monsters matter less than hospitality, disguise and recognition, and a wife who is every bit as clever as her husband.
review.zh: 第一部伟大的归乡故事，结构出奇地精巧：从儿子寻父开始，让英雄在异乡的宴席上亲口讲述奇遇，后半部几乎都发生在同一座宅院里。比起怪物，更要紧的是待客之道、伪装与相认，还有一位和丈夫一样聪明的妻子。
